statements.status_notes: A custom WADL stylesheet parameter can cause server-side requests while generating REST service descriptions. This requires the custom stylesheet configuration described by the advisory. The shipped service-description components are present, but their exposed stylesheet and URI-handling paths remain unverified. Open Liberty 26.0.0.11 ships this code inside vendor-assembled bundles. Changing a standalone library dependency does not replace that bundled implementation; a compatible vendor release or validated bundle remediation and application-specific applicability assessment remain unresolved. A base-version scanner match alone does not establish exploitability. See https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-5m3j-pxh7-455p.
